SELECT c.region_code, c.tier, COUNT(*) n FROM customers c GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.order_id IS NOT NULL) has_ship, SUM(s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL) delivered FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.shipped_ts < o.order_ts) ship_before_order, SUM(s.delivered_ts < s.shipped_ts) deliv_before_ship, AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts)) avg_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(p.payment_status='ok') ok_n FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=p.order_id WHERE o.status IN (0,9)
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.order_id<>i.order_id) order_mismatch FROM refunds r JOIN order_items i ON i.item_id=r.item_id
SELECT p.method, COUNT(*) n, SUM(p.amount_twd) amt FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status='ok' AND strftime('%Y',datetime(p.paid_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025' GROUP BY 1

SELECT SUM(strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))<>strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(p.paid_ts,'+8 hours'))) pay_month_differs_order_month, COUNT(*) n FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status='ok'
